doc_notes: This document is a collection of email drafts and final transcripts of President Bill Clinton's remarks during his November 1995 visit to Belfast, Northern Ireland, which includes a humorous reference to the 1947 Roswell incident.

incidents.summary: President Clinton addresses a letter from a 13-year-old boy named Ryan asking about the 1947 Roswell incident.
incidents.quote: No, an alien spacecraft did not crash in Roswell, New Mexico in 1947.
